text:
SpecBmad 是一个 AI 驱动的软件开发工作流工具。
SpecBmad is an AI-driven software delivery workflow.

它让分析、架构、开发、测试协同推进，并以门禁保障质量。
It aligns analysis, architecture, development, and QA with quality gates.

内置变更管理与报告，让交付透明可追溯。
Change management and reports keep every step traceable.

支持 TypeScript、Python 和 C++。
TypeScript, Python, and C plus plus are supported.
